source = '''from collections import Counter

def transform(grid):
    background = Counter(value for row in grid for value in row).most_common(1)[0][0]
    out = [row[:] for row in grid]
    for r, row in enumerate(grid):
        marked = [c for c, value in enumerate(row) if value != background]
        for left, right in zip(marked, marked[1:]):
            if right - left == 2 and row[left] == row[right]:
                out[r][left + 1] = 2
    return out
'''
path.write_text(source)
spec=spec_from_file_location('task45850099', path); mod=module_from_spec(spec); spec.loader.exec_module(mod)
